text:
tara: Heads-up 1 1 Adamas just submitted a private onboarding request for a 7B "chem-safety" model. Requirements: customer-managed HSM, PHI/PII redaction, exportable (redacted) traces, and full safety evals. They want GA in ~3 weeks. I uploaded their intake + sample prompts.

kevin: Thanks. Do they specify artifact type and quantization plan? Also what's their expected QPS and latency SLO?

tara: Artifact: safetensors PyTorch export + tokenizer. They plan int8 quant and may try 4-bit if needed. QPS steady 12, burst 60. Target p50 <240ms for 512 tokens; p95 goal <450ms. Canary for 30 days with auto-rollback on safety regressions.

diane: Please ask for a 150-example confirmed-fail set and a 1.5k safety prompt suite. We'll baseline against redwood-7b-v2. Also need list of PHI fields they expect stripped and whether they want redacted transcripts delivered back.

intake-bot: Intake created: AD-ONB-2026-410  assigned: cs-ops  priority: P1  checklist: CS-ONB-8099

tara: Uploaded artifacts: gs://redwood-cs/adamas/adamas_eval_v1.csv and model pointer s3://adamas/model.safetensors. Customer docs at: https://adamas.example/chem-safety-intake

kevin: Scheduling sync with eng + security tomorrow 9:30am PT. @diane will you own the eval harness? Also tagging infra for HSM attestation steps.

diane: I'll take evals. Plan: run 6k prompts (mix of customer examples + adversarial set) and compare NER F1, hallucination delta, and PHI leakage. Using existing harness: 
```
./eval_runner --model s3://adamas/model.safetensors \
            --prompts gs://redwood-cs/adamas/adamas_eval_v1.csv \
            --baseline redwood-7b-v2 \
            --metrics ner_f1,hallucination,phi_leak,latency
```
I'll also test quantized artifacts locally (int8, 4-bit) and report perf/quality tradeoffs. Expect first-pass by EOD Thursday.

tara: Procurement flagged renewal risk  they may pilot other vendors if p50 >300ms. Let's prioritize perf. If int8 misses SLOs suggest dedicated capacity sizing or kernel tuning.

kevin: For rollout propose: internal QA -> private canary (10%) -> ramp to 50% -> full over 2 weeks. Canary monitors: evidence extraction F1, PHI recall, hallucination delta, and latency. Auto rollback thresholds to be documented.

diane: Quick Q  do they want model weights stored in their cloud or ours? If BYO S3 we need cross-account role + signed URLs and key rotation notes.

tara: They prefer customer S3 with cross-account role. I'll add S3 access checklist and HSM key exchange steps to the intake. Also confirm exactly which trace fields they want in daily exports.

kevin: Great. We'll cover infra, evals, and compliance in tomorrow's sync. Post results and any blocker updates here.
